bios.short_bio: Mira Sol is a melodic techno project built around evolving synth lines and patient, late-night builds.
bios.long_bio: Mira Sol is a melodic techno project built around evolving synth lines and patient, late-night builds. Drawing on Four Tet and early Bonobo, the project moves through euphoric, hypnotic, late-night moods. Its sound unfolds with a sense of patience, letting the synth lines evolve as the builds gradually gather momentum.
bios.track_description: “Glass Tides” is a melodic techno track by Mira Sol, shaped by evolving synth lines and patient, late-night builds. Euphoric and hypnotic, it’s made for late-night listening. Released November 7, 2026.

pitches.subject: Mira Sol — “Glass Tides”
pitches.body:
Hi Club Meridian,

I’m sharing “Glass Tides,” a melodic techno track with euphoric moods and patient, late-night builds. Its genre matches your melodic techno listings, and its late-night energy may suit your driving, club-ready vibe.

Listen: https://soundcloud.com/example/glass-tides

Best,
Mira Sol
